scope_description.value: Merge UFGS 48 14 13.00 20 (Solar Liquid Flat Plate and Evacuated Tube Collectors) into UFGS 22 33 30.00 10 (Solar Water Heating Equipment). Update current technologies, industry standards, and energy/performance requirements. Develop matrix comparison between the two references. Review and resolve outstanding Criteria Change Requests (CCRs). Option 1: Merge UFGS 23 03 00.00 20 (Basic Mechanical Material and Methods) into the merged document. Deliverables include UFGS in Word, SpecsIntact (.sec), and PDF formats.
scope_description.quote: This project consists of all work necessary to develop the task. The final product will serve as design/construction document for facility designers/contractors Products must include requirements for accessibility, antiterrorism, security, sustainability, corrosion protection and control, and safety as applicable.

delivery_phases.notes: Five-phase iterative criteria development process with Tri-Service (Navy, Army, Air Force, USMC) and NASA review at each phase.
